data.body: Implementation validation: exactly the three declared initial JavaScript headers and one Python module docstring changed. Word counts are 128->28, 131->24, 107->29, and 139->52. The immutable-base oracle confirms every JavaScript byte from the first import onward, the Python normalized AST, line-1 shebang, directives, and protected prose remain identical. Scoped diff/Ruff/format/hygiene checks, all three Node syntax checks, the cassette self-test, and the exact browser-wrapper suite (3 passed in 148.82s) pass. Per operator direction, no local full suite was run; Gerrit Verified CI is the repository-wide gate.
